description: Plan F — Term 6 Habiro residue tail at the precision of the existing habiro-residue-symbolic.witness.json (~30 digits via sympy.evalf(30)). True 50 dps requires re-evaluating the Schur-Weyl symbolic sums in schur_weyl_symbolic.py with mp.dps=50 — separate task. Existing 30 dps is already 10^15× better than f64; Term 6 is a small contribution to the total mass so 30 dps is sufficient for sub-ppb on magic-A isotopes.
precision_floor_reason: Source habiro-residue-symbolic.witness.json was emitted by sympy.evalf(30); recomputing at 50 dps requires the global Schur-Weyl symbolic sums from schur_weyl_symbolic.py.
